sanskrit: sahasreṇa śatamānā yad eṣi lokāṃ jigetha prathamā śataudane | sarvavedasam uta vājapeyaṃ sarvām̐l lokāṃ chataudanā samāpa ||
english: Measured in hundreds, surpassing a thousand, as you go forth you have conquered the worlds, foremost O Śataudanā. She has attained the Sarvavedasa rite and the Vājapeya; all worlds the Śataudanā has encompassed.

sanskrit: indraḥ papāta prathamaḥ śataudanāṃ sapta ṛṣibhyaḥ sumanasyamānaḥ | tayāsurāṇāṃ balam oja ā dade tayā ruroha viṣṭapo devalokān ||
english: Indra partook of the Śataudanā first, graciously disposed toward the seven ṛṣis; by her he seized the strength and vigor of the asuras, by her he ascended the heights of the celestial worlds.

sanskrit: viśvāmitro 'yaṃ jamadagnir atrir bharadvājo gotamo 'yaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ | idaṃ pakvaṃ kaśyapasaptamāḥ prāśnantu prathamāḥ śataudanām ||
english: Here Viśvāmitra, Jamadagni, Atri, Bharadvāja, Gotama, and here Vasiṣṭha — these with Kaśyapa as the seventh, let them partake first of this cooked Śataudanā.

sanskrit: jyotiṣmatī prathamā śataudanā trīṇi jyotīṃṣi kṛṇute svar yatī | tāṃ dātāra upa jīvanti yatra tatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti ||
english: Luminous is the foremost Śataudanā; proceeding toward the heavenly light she fashions the three luminaries. Her givers live in prosperity; wherever they are, they rejoice in common festivity with the gods.

sanskrit: chandaḥpakṣā bṛhatī śataudanā trīṇi cchandāṃsi sasṛje svar yatī | ṛtūṇām adhirājaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ patim asyā vindan ||
english: The great Śataudanā, whose wings are the meters, going toward heaven has brought forth the three chants. They have found the year, the overlord of seasons, as her lord.

sanskrit: atikramyāgniṣṭomam atirātraṃ śataudane | yajñāṃs tvaṃ sarvān āptvā cityam agniṃ vy aśnuhi ||
english: Surpassing the Agniṣṭoma and the Atirātra, O Śataudanā — having attained all the sacrifices, spread wide through the fire-altar built in layers.

sanskrit: aśvamedhyam atikramya dvādaśāhaṃ śataudane | trirātraṃ sāhnam āptvā vājapeyena kalpate ||
english: Surpassing what belongs to the Aśvamedha and the Dvādaśāha, O Śataudanā — having attained the three-night rite with the press-day, she equals the Vājapeya.

sanskrit: ye sahasrair ījānā agnihotrahutaś ca ye | yajñair ye sarvair ījānās tān āpnoti śataudanā ||
english: Those who have sacrificed with thousands of offerings, those who have presented oblations in the Agnihotra, those who have sacrificed with all sacrifices — all of these the Śataudanā attains.

sanskrit: śaṃ te parūṃṣi subhage dadhāmi śaṃ te māṃsāny attathā bhavanti | asthi yat te śamitā śaśāra tat te tvaṣṭā vihṛtaṃ niṣ kṛṇotu ||
english: Auspicious I make your joints, O blessed one; auspicious too are the portions of flesh that are consumed. Whatever bone the sacrificial slaughterer has broken — that which is disjointed in you, let Tvaṣṭṛ restore.

sanskrit: ye yajñena jitā lokā yā nu cchandāṃsi bhejire | sarvāṃs tām̐l lokān āpnoti yo dadāti śataudanām ||
english: Whatever worlds have been won by sacrifice, whatever meters have been obtained — all those worlds does he attain who gives the Śataudanā.

sanskrit: iṣirā yoṣā yuvatīr damūnā rātrī devasya savitur bhagasya | aśvakṣatā suhavā saṃbhṛtaśrīr ā paprau dyāvāpṛthivī mahitvā ||
english: Vibrant, a maiden, youthful, dwelling within the house — Night belonging to the divine Savitṛ and Bhaga; unharmed as a horse, easy to invoke, her splendor gathered, she has filled heaven and earth with her greatness.

sanskrit: ava viśvāny aruhad gabhīrā- -udvarṣiṣṭham aruhad aśramiṣṭhā | uśatī rātry anu sānu bhadrād vi tiṣṭhate mitra iva svadhābhiḥ ||
english: Deep, she has descended over all things; tireless, she has ascended to the highest peak. Eager Night spreads out along the benign ridge, like Mitra with her own powers.

sanskrit: narye vandye subhage sujāta ā cāgan rātri sumanā iha syām | asmāṃs trāyasva naryāṇi jātā- -aśvyā yāni gavyāni puṣṭā ||
english: O Night, worthy of heroes, deserving of praise, blessed, nobly born — come hither; be well-disposed; may I be here with cheerful mind. Protect us with the riches born of heroes, the ample wealth in horses and in cattle.

sanskrit: siṃhasya rātry uśatī piśasya vyāghrasya dvīpino varca ā dade | aśvasya bradhnaṃ puruṣasya māyaṃ puru rūpāṇi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī ||
english: Eager Night, you have assumed the splendor of the lion, of the piśāca, of the tiger, of the leopard; the redness of the horse, the wizardry of man — shining abroad, you take on many forms.

sanskrit: śivāṃ rātrim ahni sūryaṃ ca himasya mātā suhavā no astu | asya stomasya subhage ni bodha yena tvā vande viśvāsu dikṣu ||
english: Propitious Night and Sun by day — the mother of frost, easy to invoke, be good to us. O blessed one, heed this hymn of praise whereby I honor you in all directions.

sanskrit: stomasya no vibhāvari rātri rājeva joṣasai | asāma sarvavīrā bhavāma sarvavedaso vyucchantīr anūṣasaḥ ||
english: O Night of brilliant radiance, take pleasure in our praise as a king takes pleasure. May we be possessed of all heroes, may we be possessed of all wealth, as you shine forth continuously, one Dawn after another.

sanskrit: śamyā ha nāma dadhiṣe mama dipsanti ye dhanā | rātrīha tān asad apa- -atha steno na vidyate atha ripur na vidyate ||
english: You indeed bear the name Śamyā; those who would despoil my wealth — here let Night drive those away; then shall no thief be found, then shall no enemy be found.

sanskrit: bhadrāsi rātri camaso na piṣṭo viśvaṃ gorūpaṃ yuvatir bibharṣi | cakṣuṣmatī me mṛśatī vapūṃṣi prādityān divyān rukmām̐ amukthāḥ ||
english: You are auspicious, O Night, like a pressed cup; youthful, you uphold all that is of the form of the cow. Seeing with full eyes, touching my forms, you have released the divine golden ornaments belonging to the Ādityas.

sanskrit: yo adya stena āyaty aghāyur martyo ripuḥ | rātrī tasya pratītya pra grīvā pra śiro hanat ||
english: Whosoever today comes as a thief, a mortal of sinful life, an enemy — encountering him, may Night strike off his throat, strike off his head.

sanskrit: pra pādau na yathāyati pra hastau na yathāśiṣat | yo malimlar upāyati sa saṃpiṣṭo apāyati | apāyati sv apāyati śuṣke sthāṇāv apāyata ||
english: His feet go not forward as they go, his hands do not reach as they stretch. Whosoever approaches in filth — crushed, he departs. He departs indeed, he departs; he has departed onto the dry stump.

sanskrit: andhaṃ rātri tiṣṭhadhūmam aśīrṣāṇam ahiṃ kṛṇu | akṣau vṛkasya nir jahy ā stenaṃ drupade jahi ||
english: O Night, make the serpent blind, motionless as smoke, headless. Strike out the eyes of the wolf; strike the thief into the wooden trap.

sanskrit: ye te rātry anaḍvāhas tīkṣṇaśṛṅgāḥ svāśavaḥ | tebhir no adya pāraya- -ati durgāṇi viśvahā ||
english: O Night, whatever bullocks of yours are sharp-horned and swift-footed — with them carry us across today, ever carrying us beyond all difficult passages.

sanskrit: rātriṃ rātrim ariṣyantas tarema tanvā vayam | gambhīram aplavā iva na tareyur arātayaḥ ||
english: Night after night, passing through unharmed in body, may we cross over; may our enemies not cross, as those who cannot swim through the deep.

sanskrit: yathā śāmyākaḥ prapatan predivān nānu vidyate | evā rātri pra pātaya yo asmām̐ abhy aghāyati ||
english: As a millet grain falling down, cast upward, is found no more — even so, O Night, cast down the one who plots evil against us.

sanskrit: apa stenaṃ vāsomathaṃ goajam uta taskaram | atho yo arvataḥ śiro +'bhidhāya ninīṣati ||
english: Drive away the thief, the plunderer of dwelling, the cattle-stealer, and the robber; and also him who, having tied a rope about a horse's head, would lead it off.

sanskrit: yad adya rātri subhage vibhajanty ayovasu | yad ehy asmān bhrājaya- -athed anyān upāyasi ||
english: Whatever iron-rich wealth they distribute today, O Night of great blessing — come, make us resplendent with it; thereafter you approach others.

sanskrit: uṣase naḥ pari dehi sarvān rātry anāgasaḥ | uṣā no ahna ā bhajād ahas tubhyaṃ vibhāvari ||
english: Hand us over to Dawn entirely guiltless, O Night. May Dawn give us a share of the day; the day belongs to you, O Night of brilliant radiance.
